subject: question: how to omit some X-axis values

messages.author: 5ceb0f6ec9a8abb8
messages.subject: question: how to omit some X-axis values
parts:
Hi everyone,

My x axis has many values and I am using facet_wrap. One x value appears written over the next one even when I use 

axis.text.x = theme_text(angle=90).

My x axis has values from 1985 to 2010. Does anyone know what I have to do to omit some x-values in the x axis of the plot? It would be enough whether it appears years from 5 to 5 (1985, 1990, 1995... 2010) or less than that.

Thanks in advance for any help.

--
Diogo Ferrari
Department of Political Science
University Of San Paulo

>
> axis.text.x = theme_text(angle=90).
>
> My x axis has values from 1985 to 2010. Does anyone know what I have to do
> to omit some x-values in the x axis of the plot? It would be enough whether
> it appears years from 5 to 5 (1985, 1990, 1995... 2010) or less than that.

Is x factor, numeric or something else? I'm guessing factor, but
you've provided no information so I can't tell for sure. A
reproducible example would be helpful. That said, find the appropriate
scale function and study the breaks = argument. You may need to use
scale_x_discrete(), scale_x_continuous() or some other scale function
depending on the class of x.

For example, if x is a factor, then this might work (untested):
scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(1985, 2010, by = 5))
